title: Bachiatari oyako: Gifu mo musume mo gehin de kekkou.
original_title: 罰当たり親子　義父も娘も下品で結構。
overview: Taku is devastated by the loss of his beloved wife, while his daughter, Yuri, struggles to find the right words to comfort her grieving father. Then, Taku’s wife’s mobile phone suddenly rings; upon checking it, he discovers a message from someone identified as "Slave"…
